```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Loads the library
library(gganimate)
# Other libraries that will be used
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

```


```{r}
# Create a dataset
data <- tibble(salary = c(1000, 2000), 
               year = c(2019, 2020))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data,
       aes(x = year,
           y = salary))+ 
  geom_point(size=4)

```
